items.headline: Pac-12 matchup features No. 20 Boise State playing Colorado State
items.description: No. 20 Boise State (7-1) at Colorado State (3-5), Nov. 7 at 6 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Hillstead has a pair of scores, defense dominates as Utah State tops Colorado State 31-14
items.description: — McCae Hillstead threw for a touchdown and ran for another and the Utah State defense had a dominant first half in a 31-14 win over Colorado State on Saturday.

items.headline: Utah State and Colorado State meet in Pac-12 play
items.description: Colorado State (3-4) at Utah State (2-5), Oct. 31 at 3:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Hauss Hejny's 5 total touchdowns power Colorado State in 56-49 win over San Diego State
items.description: — Hauss Hejny accounted for five touchdowns — three passing and two rushing — and Colorado State snapped a four-game losing streak, holding off San Diego State 56-49 on Saturday night.
